title: Strong and big
text: Strong and big. I love this box. It is a very strong and sturdy plastic that is a bit flexable..not like the hard plastics. Has a nice window/door to open. Houses a very large pair of man shoes so it will be great to store anything in it. Has 2 very strong magnets to keep it closed..hint..do NOT take out the 2 tiny screws because That's what the magnet gets attracted to to keep the door closed. I have one issue with this box..dang!! You need 9 hands to hold, keep in place , snap the side in etc. To put it together lol ! Other than that its a great box.
